notes.after: What is it?" He said, "This is the ephah
notes.text: An ephah is a measure of volume of about 22 litres, 5.8 U. S. gallons, 4.8 imperial gallons, or a bit more than half a bushel.
A talent is a weight of about 34 kilograms or 75 pounds.

notes.after: f supplication; and they will look to me
notes.text: After "me," the Hebrew has the two letters "Aleph Tav" (the first and last letters of the Hebrew alphabet), not as a word, but as a grammatical marker.
